product_summary: Website dhagalstones.com (copyright line 'dhgalstones Pvt. Ltd.', address: shop no.2, Dhanmandi, Dharamkata, Undailiya ki Dungri, Bundi, Rajasthan; contacts +91 8000321808 India / +91 9351521190 and +79520634669 Russia; email dhagalstones13@gmail.com). Declared product lines: GRANITE, MARBLE, QUARTZ (top menu). Text: 'premium provider of granite products', 'processed Indian gangsaw granite slabs', 'we extract, process, and finish our granite', products 'from counter tops and flooring to tiles and slabs'. Featured products: Absolute Black, Alaska White, Alaska Gold, Alaska Red, Azul Nova, Bruno Red, Coffee Brown, Copper Silk. Quick links / footer: Black Galaxy, Lakha Red, Indian grey quartzite, Moon White, Multi Colour, Red Monalisa, Ivory Brown, Tiger Skin, Blue Dunes, Bidasar Brown Marble, Black Forest, Toronto Fantasy, New Imperial Red granite, Indian green marble. News items: Cristallo Quartzite ('our new quarry'), River Grey Quartzite. So the real range is: gangsaw granite slabs/tiles (worked stone), marble slabs (Bidasar Brown, Indian green marble), and quartzite (Cristallo, River Grey) sold as slabs/countertops. Quartzite is geologically not granite and is classified as other monumental/building stone, not under 6802.23.
comment: Declared 6802.23 (granite, merely cut into blocks/slabs) and 6802.93 (other granite, worked) are corroborated by the site: gangsaw granite slabs and tiles/countertops — these two lines are consistent with the stated product line. However the declaration is incomplete and partly mis-mapped: (1) marble slabs (Bidasar Brown Marble, Indian green marble) belong to 6802.91 (marble, worked) — missing from the declaration; (2) quartzite slabs (Cristallo Quartzite, River Grey Quartzite, Indian grey quartzite) belong to 6802.99 (other stone, worked) — missing; (3) the site claims 'we extract' and 'our new quarry', which would imply raw block extraction under 2516.12 (granite blocks) and 2506.20 (quartzite blocks) — not declared, and the quarry claim is asserted only on the site. Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) is a misclassification of the trade: this is a stone processor/exporter of natural stone slabs, not a construction or DIY retailer. Trader signs: registered address is a shop in a market area (shop no.2, Dhanmandi), a gmail contact, and a Russian phone number alongside the Indian one — consistent with a small trading/export intermediary rather than a quarry-owning processor; the 'we extract' wording is marketing and is not corroborated. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task (out of scope), so nothing here is confirmed as an actual shipment. No HS-based rejection: company is retained, code list corrected/expanded to 6802.23 + 6802.93 + 6802.91 (marble) + 6802.99 (quartzite/other stone), with 2516.12/2506.20 as unverified raw-block possibility. Note: search engines were unavailable/blocked during this check (searx connection refused, Google 429, Bing returned irrelevant results, Zauba/CompanyCheck 403), so verification rests solely on the company's own website homepage; subpages (/products/, /granite/, /about-us/) returned 404 and could not be read. No revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN data was researched or is asserted here.
